none: PAS NLM-FC4AF6: NLM-FC4AF6: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Probably commemorative issue of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: possibly bust left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf Suckling Twins. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, which has been heavily cleaned. Diameter: 15.0mm, Weight: 1.43gms
